definition: High-quality randomized controlled or controlled-feeding intervention with a validated redox outcome
minimum_requirements: Randomization; appropriate comparator; validated endpoint; RoB 2 low or some concerns; relevant dose
confidence_rule: Downgrade for high RoB imprecision indirectness or implausible exposure
notes: Clinical outcome and redox biomarker must be recorded separately

minimum_requirements: Prospective control; prespecified redox endpoint; adequate adherence and analysis
confidence_rule: Use ROBINS-I V2 and downgrade serious confounding

minimum_requirements: Temporal ordering; exposure ascertainment; confounder control
example_evidence: Cohort relating biomarker-confirmed intake to oxidative damage
confidence_rule: Downgrade residual confounding and exposure error

minimum_requirements: Defined population; valid exposure and outcome; core confounders
example_evidence: Population survey with intake and F2-isoprostane data
confidence_rule: Cap when reverse causation likely
notes: Human disease-only outcome without redox endpoint is indirect

definition: Human PK bioavailability or metabolite exposure
minimum_requirements: Identified analyte; validated bioanalysis; dose and sampling schedule
example_evidence: Cmax and AUC of parent and conjugates
confidence_rule: Supports exposure only and cannot be promoted by count

minimum_requirements: Search completed with no eligible evidence
confidence_rule: Distinguish searched_none from not_searched

definition: Human intervention improves validated oxidative stress or damage endpoint
minimum_requirements: Controlled human evidence; reliable endpoint; appropriate statistics
confidence_rule: Downgrade weak assay or high RoB

definition: In-vivo animal redox or oxidative-damage improvement
minimum_requirements: Whole-animal exposure; validated tissue or systemic endpoint; controls
example_evidence: Reduced lipid oxidation with exposure confirmation
confidence_rule: Downgrade excessive dose or weak model

minimum_requirements: Intact-cell endpoint; viability control; dose response; method validity
confidence_rule: Downgrade nonspecific probes and supraphysiological dose

minimum_requirements: Defined biological matrix but limited physiological inference
confidence_rule: Cap if artefactual oxidation cannot be excluded

minimum_requirements: Defined chemistry and assay conditions
example_evidence: DPPH ABTS FRAP ORAC metal chelation
confidence_rule: Never promote across assay types

minimum_requirements: Genetic or selective pharmacologic dependency plus rescue or reversal
example_evidence: KO abolishes effect and re-expression rescues
confidence_rule: Require specificity and coherent direction

definition: Explicit functional mechanism without full causal rescue
minimum_requirements: Multiple functional assays and pathway-specific controls
example_evidence: Enzyme activity and redox flux support mechanism
confidence_rule: Downgrade alternative mechanisms not excluded

minimum_requirements: Activity phosphorylation localization or nuclear translocation with functional endpoint
example_evidence: Nrf2 nuclear translocation plus GSH response
confidence_rule: Redox endpoint required for antioxidant claim

minimum_requirements: RNA or protein abundance association
confidence_rule: No causal wording

minimum_requirements: Specified algorithm and input with no wet-lab validation
confidence_rule: Hypothesis generating only

minimum_requirements: Defined protein; quantitative binding or resolved structure; interference controls; preferably orthogonal validation
confidence_rule: Downgrade aggregation optical or covalent artefact

minimum_requirements: Competition or dose-response; appropriate controls; directness assessed
confidence_rule: Ambiguous intact-cell TPP may be downgraded
notes: Only qualified T2 enters direct layer

minimum_requirements: KO KD OE mutation or rescue establishes necessity
confidence_rule: Must not be labelled direct target

minimum_requirements: Expression phosphorylation localization or activity change
confidence_rule: No directness claim

minimum_requirements: Algorithm version input structure and score documented
confidence_rule: No promotion by multiple correlated predictions

definition: Quantified meaningful dietary exposure in multiple populations
minimum_requirements: Validated food concentration plus consumption data and intake estimate
confidence_rule: Downgrade heterogeneity and outdated consumption data
notes: Global coverage is not required for every compound

definition: Quantified meaningful exposure in one population or several foods
minimum_requirements: Reliable concentration and consumption evidence
confidence_rule: Keep population-specific

definition: Quantified food content with plausible consumption
minimum_requirements: Validated quantitative composition but no compound-specific intake estimate
confidence_rule: Processing and units required
notes: Estimate later when consumption becomes available

minimum_requirements: Identity credible but amount or consumption inadequate
confidence_rule: Cannot exceed 0.20 by occurrence count

minimum_requirements: Search completed without qualifying record
confidence_rule: Route to extended list

definition: Human dietary and intervention safety characterized
minimum_requirements: Exposure range adverse events and authoritative limits assessed
example_evidence: Food and trial dose window characterized
confidence_rule: Confidence depends on population and duration
notes: Not part of early total score

minimum_requirements: Some intervention or surveillance evidence but gaps remain
confidence_rule: Flag special populations
notes: Absence of adverse events is not proof of safety

minimum_requirements: Animal or in-vitro evidence without adequate human data
confidence_rule: Do not infer human threshold

minimum_requirements: Formal search completed with inadequate data
confidence_rule: Unknown is not safe
